# PAYLOAD_REDACTIONS — the four strings that could not be redacted for free

**Generated by `tools/anonymize_release.py --apply-payload`.**

`tools/anonymize_release.py --apply` redacts the **provenance block**, which is
excluded from `payload_sha256` by construction, so 66 files were cleaned with every
hash unchanged - and that invariance is the test that the rewriter touched no number.

These three files are different. The identity string sat in a **payload** key, so
redacting it necessarily moves the hash. Leaving it was not an option; moving a hash
silently was not either. Both hashes are recorded, in the file and here.

No numeric value was altered. The redactions are confined to filesystem paths.

| results file | key | payload_sha256 before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `results/r8_ladder_flatness.json` | absolute path / input filename | `14189ffb8ecd745b` | `78872b29ecc59b6c` |
